conditions: Female of Pharta roseomaculata Dhiya’ulhaq & Benjamin, sp. nov. Measured specimen: the Description lead-in reads 'Female (holotype 2013_HF1.1_AraThom044N_001, Figs 21, 22).' 'Type material.' prints, in full (pieces joined): 'Holotype. Indonesia – Jambi Province • 1♀; Batang Hari, Hutan Harapan Conservation Area; 02°09'09.3"S, 103°21'41.8"E; elev. 65 m; 19 Jul. 2013; J. Drescher leg.; canopy fogging in rainforest; GOET 2013_HF1.1_AraThom044N_001 (to be transferred to MZB).' No paratype is printed; only the female is described and no male sentence is printed. Sentences around the quoted one, in printed order: 'Abdomen length 3.31; width 2.63.' then the quoted eye sentence, then 'Interdistances between eyes: AME–AME 0.10; AME–ALE 0.13; ALE–ALE 0.44; PME–PME 0.21; PME–PLE 0.17; ALE–PLE 0.17; AME–PME 0.26; PLE–PLE 0.64.' Methods (Materials and methods, publisher article_preview page, whole section read in pieces, audit 755): subheadings 'Sample collection', 'Identification and photography', 'Abbreviations', 'Repositories'; the measurement sentences are 'Specimens were examined under a ZEISS Stemi 2000 microscope.' 'The specimens were measured and imaged using a KEYENCE VHX–7000 digital microscope system.' 'Measurements of legs are given as total length (femur, patella, tibia, metatarsus, tarsus).' 'All measurements are in millimetres.' Abbreviations print 'AME anterior median eye;' 'ALE anterior lateral eye;' 'PME posterior median eye;' 'PLE posterior lateral eye;'. No Methods sentence uses 'eye', 'diameter' or 'ocular' outside the Abbreviations list, so the Methods define no eye dimension; the diameter reading rests on the printed sentence label 'Diameter of eyes' (desk-d377 and desk-d393 precedent: a sentence label naming diameters keeps eye_diameter_mm). Printed unit: mm. No Class or Order heading is printed; Interdistances are not filed.
